content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are doing well. I am writing to suggest a minor adjustment to the agreement before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause, ownership transfers to the client immediately upon creation before payment is received. I propose modifying this so that ownership is assigned to the client upon receipt of full payment for the applicable work. Thank you for your flexibility.
